subtitle: Out Manila · Shenzhen Airlines
overview: Fly to Shenzhen with Shenzhen Airlines and transfer to Guangzhou, where you stay three nights in a 4★ hotel. Two days are set aside for the Canton Fair, with pick-up and dinner arranged, and the tour starts and ends with Guangzhou and Shenzhen sights. The tour has an English-speaking guide and private coach.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Apr 16–19 2027 to Apr 23–26 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Huacheng Square: A large public square in Guangzhou's Zhujiang New Town, beside the Canton Tower.
placeDesc.Canton Tower: Guangzhou's slender TV tower and city landmark, viewed from outside.
placeDesc.Beijing Pedestrian Street: A pedestrian shopping and dining street in downtown Guangzhou.
placeDesc.Great Buddha Temple: A Buddhist temple in Guangzhou's old city, visited on Day 1.
placeDesc.Canton Fair: China's large import and export trade fair in Guangzhou; two days at the fair are in this tour.
placeDesc.Longgang Robot Block: A robot-themed shopping block in Shenzhen with China's first Robot 6S store.
placeDesc.Huaqiangbei Electronics Market: Shenzhen's huge electronics market district for gadgets and components.
placeDesc.Uniwalk Qianhai: A shopping and dining area in Shenzhen's Qianhai district, visited before the flight.
